native_mechanisms: Pour each mark one at a time into a never-pure (impure, nonzero) cup, letting the cup's changed state seed the next pull, so the whole pile passes as one unbroken chained pour with no mark judged alone or twice.
Carry the cup's final state through seven successive 'organ' bendings, each discarding half of what it received and passing on only the bits that disagree/refuse to sit still.
Validate by flipping one mark anywhere in the pile, re-pouring from the first cup, and discarding the entire method if the new token resembles the old one (strict avalanche rejection test).
core_technique: wyhash/xxHash-style buffer folding: 128-bit widening multiply folded by hi^lo (mum) over four parallel accumulator lanes for >=64-byte blocks, a 16-byte single-accumulator chained loop, overlapping-read tail, length injection, and a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer extended by two extra multiply-xorshift steps.
